We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Wang Moujia contracted a construction group for external wall insulation. To settle payment, he paid 37,000 RMB to have someone help him to fraudulently issue a VAT ordinary invoice (增值税普通发票) from Dalian city, with unit being a building hardware company, amount total 1,257,814.95 RMB. The invoice is fake (virtual). This is virtual invoice issuance, i.e., false invoicing, which is a crime of "虚开增值税专用发票罪" or "虚开普通发票罪". In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (illegal issuance of special VAT invoices) and "虚开普通发票罪". The facts mention "增值税普通发票". So the crime is "虚开增值税普通发票罪". In the examples, they used labels like "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;逃税". For ordinary invoice, they might label as "虚开增值税普通发票". In earlier example: "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具" etc. So we need to output the crime(s). Likely just one: 虚开增值税普通发票. Possibly also "逃税" if they didn't pay tax? But the fact only mentions virtual invoice for settlement, not tax evasion. The crime is "虚开增值税普通发票罪". So answer: [罪名]虚开增值税普通发票<eoa>.
